items.title: 9.1 Introduction to Design Thinking and Business Solutions (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Unit 9 student learning outcomes (PDF 207). Roman Urdu explanation of topic 9.1 (PDF 208), rewritten 2026-10-27 to follow the book paragraph for paragraph.

blocks.text: Student Learning Outcomes (is unit mein kya seekhenge)
Is unit ke aakhir tak aap yeh kar sakenge:

items: Entrepreneurship (apna karobar shuru karna) ke bunyadi concepts aur aaj ki maeeshat (economy) mein iski ahmiyat samajh sakenge.
Design Thinking ke usool aur tareeqe samjha sakenge aur yeh bhi ke karobari hal (business solutions) mein yeh kaise kaam aate hain.
Mukammal business plan bana sakenge, jis mein market analysis (bazaar ka jaiza), financial projections (aamdani aur kharche ke andaze) aur operational strategies (kaam chalane ka tareeqa) hon.
Bazaar ki maloomat (market insights) jama kar ke samajh sakenge taake soch samajh kar karobari faisle ho sakein.
Mukhtalif sunne walon (audiences) ke mutabiq asar daar business pitch (karobar ka mukhtasar taaruf) bana aur pesh kar sakenge.
Karobar ke maqasid aur target markets (jin logon ko bechna hai) ke mutabiq marketing aur sales ki strategies bana sakenge.

Kamyab karobar chalane ke liye zaroori maali (financial) concepts samajh sakenge, jaise budgeting (bajat banana), cash flow management (paise ke aane jaane ka intezam) aur financial forecasting (maali andaza).
Karobar ka vision (maqsad) achhi tarah batane aur stakeholders (karobar se jude log) se taalluq banane ke liye communication aur storytelling (kahani ke andaz mein batana) ki skills barha sakenge.
Karobari ideas aur hal ko behtar banane mein collaboration (mil kar kaam) aur iteration (baar baar behtar karna) ki ahmiyat pehchan sakenge.
Karobar ki kamyabi aur asal zindagi ke masail hal karne mein innovation (nayi soch) aur creativity (takhleeqi salahiyat) ka kirdaar samajh sakenge.

blocks.text: Is chapter mein hum entrepreneurship (apna karobar shuru karna aur chalana) ke aham pehlu parhenge, yaani woh skills (maharatein) aur strategies (kaam ke soche samjhe tareeqe) jo karobar ki kamyabi ke liye zaroori hain. Chapter innovation (nayi soch se behtari), creativity (takhleeqi soch) aur problem-solving (masle ka hal) ki ahmiyat batata hai, aur Design Thinking ko aisa tareeqa batata hai jo insan ko markaz bana kar (human-centered) achhe business solutions banata hai. Phir yeh business plan banana, market insights (bazaar ki maloomat) jama karna aur investors (paisa lagane walon) ke saamne apna idea pitch karna (pesh karna) sikhata hai. Is ke ilawa marketing aur sales ki strategies, financial concepts (paise ke bunyadi tasawwurat), aur communication (baat cheet), collaboration (mil kar kaam) aur iteration (baar baar behtar karna) ki ahmiyat bhi batata hai. Aakhir mein yeh dikhata hai ke innovation aur creativity naye hal nikalne aur maujooda products aur services ko behtar banane mein kya kirdar ada karti hain.
Aayiye dekhein ke Design Thinking jaise creative tareeqe karobaron ko mushkilat ka saamna karne aur customers (gahakon) ki zarooratein behtar tareeqe se poori karne mein kaise madad dete hain.

blocks.prompt: Entrepreneurship ki apne alfaaz mein definition (tareef) likhiye (short question 1). Entrepreneurship ka bunyadi maqsad kya hai (MCQ 1)?
blocks.explanation: Entrepreneurship ka matlab hai kisi masle ya mauqe ko pehchanna, kuch risk (khatra) utha kar aisa karobar shuru karna jo us masle ko hal kare, aur log is hal ke liye paise dene ko tayyar hon. MCQ 1: (b) masle hal karna aur value (qadr) paida karna. Chapter is lafz ki seedhi definition nahi deta; yeh definition aam maloomat se hai.

items: Entrepreneurship: karobar ke zariye masle hal karna aur value (qadr) paida karna.
Chapter ke hisse: Design Thinking, business plan, market insights, pitch, marketing aur sales, financial concepts, communication, collaboration, iteration, innovation aur creativity.
